📰 General

Russia and Ukraine Engage in U.S.-Mediated Talks in Abu Dhabi •

Representatives from Russia and Ukraine held nearly four hours of discussions in Abu Dhabi, facilitated by the United States. U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio described the meeting as “very productive,” marking the first U.S.-mediated talks between the two nations in nine months. The discussions centered on de-escalating the conflict and establishing a framework for future negotiations. Both sides acknowledged the need for continued dialogue to address key concerns and explore potential pathways toward a resolution.

🌍 World

Polish Gunman Showed Interest in Breivik’s Ideology, Minister Reveals •

The attacker responsible for the Krakow shooting, who killed six individuals, had accessed websites containing information about Norwegian mass killer Anders Behring Breivik. Polish Justice Minister Robert Kwiatkowski stated this discovery was made during the ongoing investigation into the motives behind the attack. Investigators found evidence suggesting the gunman was influenced by Breivik’s extremist views and writings. The investigation is continuing to explore the extent of this influence and its potential connection to the crime.

🦅 US

Report: US Authorities Failed to Prevent Jeffrey Epstein’s Crimes •

A newly released congressional investigation has determined that federal authorities could have intervened and potentially prevented numerous crimes committed by Jeffrey Epstein after 2005. The investigation attributed these failures to shortcomings within the Justice Department’s handling of Epstein’s case. Specifically, investigators found a lack of proactive investigation and insufficient scrutiny of Epstein’s activities. The report highlights missed opportunities to pursue charges related to sex trafficking and other offenses.

💰 Business

SpaceX Enters Lunar Race as NASA Announces $10 Billion Base Building Contracts •

NASA has selected eight companies, including SpaceX, Blue Origin, and Lockheed Martin Space, to compete for contracts totaling up to $10 billion. The agency’s initiative aims to establish a permanent lunar base through scaled-up transportation and infrastructure development. SpaceX’s inclusion signifies a direct challenge to established players in the space industry seeking to contribute to the ambitious project. The competition will focus on delivering equipment and resources necessary for constructing a sustainable lunar outpost.

💻 Technology

Maury Povich Reveals San Francisco’s Unexpected Dating Spot: The Marina Safeway •

TV personality Maury Povich recounted a time when he frequented the Safeway grocery store in San Francisco’s Marina District to meet potential romantic partners. Prior to the rise of dating apps, this location served as a popular meeting place for locals seeking relationships. Povich described the experience as a surprisingly common way for San Franciscans to connect. The story highlights a nostalgic look at pre-app dating trends in the city.

🎭 Entertainment

Dax Shepard Defends Himself Amid Online Criticism of Marriage to Kristen Bell •

Actor Dax Shepard is responding to a recent wave of online criticism regarding his relationship with Kristen Bell. The controversy originated with a viral video depicting Shepard seemingly dismissing Bell’s concerns about their marriage. Shepard addressed the backlash, stating he had previously avoided similar media attention but now feels compelled to defend himself and his wife. He acknowledged the criticism as a direct impact on Bell and emphasized the importance of addressing the concerns raised.

🏅 Sports

Manchester United’s Carrick Future Hinges on Monaco Meeting Discussions •

Manchester United’s head coach, Michael Carrick, will discuss his future with the club during a meeting in Monaco on Wednesday. Chief executive Omar Berrada and director of football Jason Wilcox are travelling to the city to hold the scheduled discussions. The meeting is part of a regular process for the club to assess managerial situations. Details of the discussions remain confidential, but the outcome will significantly impact Carrick’s position at Old Trafford.

🔬 Science

Astronomers Discover First Ever Disappearing Planet – A Cosmic Mystery Unfolds •

Astronomers have identified TOI-2535 b, a distant “hot Jupiter” planet, as the first ever observed to completely vanish from existence. Observations over several years revealed the planet’s orbit shrinking dramatically, leading to its eventual disappearance. Scientists tracked the planet’s orbital decay, which took approximately 8.25 years, ultimately causing it to cross inside its star’s inner edge. This event marks a unique phenomenon in planetary science, offering a rare opportunity to study a planet’s demise.

🩺 Health

Experimental Electric Comb Shows Promise in Early Tests Against Hair Loss •

Researchers at Beihang University in China have developed an experimental electrical comb designed to stimulate hair growth. The device delivers low-voltage electrical pulses to the scalp, targeting hair follicles. Initial tests conducted on mice demonstrated a significant increase in hair growth compared to control groups. Scientists believe the electrical stimulation encourages hair follicles to produce more hair, potentially offering a novel approach to treating baldness. Further research is planned to assess the comb’s efficacy and safety in humans.
